evd_title: Human inter-rater reliability dropped from 91 percent on PRISMA to 57 percent on PRECIS-2
finding: Human inter-rater reliability dropped from 91 percent on PRISMA to 57 percent on PRECIS-2
P: 112 SRs/MAs in pediatric surgery (Cullis et al.) for PRISMA/AMSTAR; 56 RCTs from PragMeta for PRECIS-2
I: None (human inter-rater reliability of the reference standard)
C: Human rater 1 vs human rater 2 (pediatric surgeons; PRECIS-2 reviewer + MSc student/epidemiologist)
O: Human IRR: PRISMA 91%, kappa 0.84; AMSTAR 88%, kappa 0.77; PRECIS-2 57%, weighted kappa 0.29
S: Secondary analysis of existing human ratings
T: Not reported on page; models queried Aug 2023-Apr 2024 per Woelfle cost EVD (paper 2024)
